items_flat.title_en: Sam Altman Demonstrates ChatGPT Work Completing Complex Multi-Step Agentic Tasks from Mobile
items_flat.title_zh: Sam Altman 示範 ChatGPT Work 從手機完成複雜多步驟 Agentic 任務
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman posted that ChatGPT Work is “remarkable” and that “work” undersells it. From his phone he prompted it to use all his chat history to generate long-weekend trip ideas for eight friends, plan the best three options, build a full-stack coordination site for the group, make reservations after agreement, and draft a Gmail email — reporting that it just worked.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 發文稱 ChatGPT Work「出色」，「work」一詞還不足以形容。他從手機下指令，要求系統根據全部聊天紀錄為八位朋友規劃長週末行程、選出最佳三方案、打造全端協調網站、達成共識後訂位，並草擬 Gmail 郵件，結果「就這樣完成了」。
items_flat.analysis_en: This CEO-level real-user demo from mobile underscores maturing reliability of agentic workflows that chain research, coding, external tools and communication end-to-end. It positions ChatGPT Work as a practical multi-tool agent for complex planning, though broader user success rates and access constraints remain unconfirmed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這則由執行長親自從手機示範的真實案例，凸顯 agentic 工作流在串接研究、寫碼、外部工具與溝通上的端到端成熟度。它把 ChatGPT Work 定位成複雜規劃的實用多工具 agent，但一般使用者成功率與權限限制仍待更多驗證。
items_flat.quote: chatgpt work is remarkable, and "work" undersells it. ... it...just worked.
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT Work 出色，「work」一詞還不足以形容。……就這樣完成了。

items_flat.title_en: xAI / Elon Musk Promote Grok Build CLI Updates Including Tutorial, Voice Prompting and Deep-Research
items_flat.title_zh: xAI／Elon Musk 推廣 Grok Build CLI 更新：教學指令、語音提示與深度研究
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk posted multiple times promoting Grok Build, highlighting a new /tutorial command, voice prompting (Ctrl+Space), reliability improvements, workflow progress tracking, one-click resume, and the /deep-research command that uses bounded parallel agents to cross-check evidence and write cited reports. He also described Grok 4.5 as a solid workhorse.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 多次發文推廣 Grok Build，強調新增 /tutorial 指令、語音提示（Ctrl+Space）、可靠度提升、工作流進度追蹤、一鍵恢復失敗任務，以及 /deep-research 指令（使用有界平行 agents 交叉驗證證據並產出引用報告）。他也稱 Grok 4.5 是穩固的工作馬。
items_flat.analysis_en: These incremental CLI and interaction updates reinforce xAI’s focus on practical developer tooling and agent reliability rather than a new frontier model release. The emphasis on voice and deep-research agents aims to lower friction for complex coding and research workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些漸進式 CLI 與互動更新，凸顯 xAI 聚焦實用開發者工具與 agent 可靠度，而非發布全新 frontier 模型。語音與深度研究 agents 的強調，旨在降低複雜寫碼與研究工作流的摩擦。
items_flat.quote: Download Grok Build and type /tutorial ... Grok Build /deep-research
items_flat.quote_zh: 下載 Grok Build 並輸入 /tutorial …… Grok Build /deep-research
